Layer.Title: European House Borer - Restricted Movement Zones (DPIRD-052)
Layer.Abstract:
European house borer (EHB), Hylotrupes bajulus Linnaeus, is a destructive pest of seasoned coniferous timber including pine, fir and spruce. If allowed to become established it can cause major structural damage to buildings.
This data set shows Restricted Movement Zones (RMZ) surrounding areas in which EHB has been found. Restricted movement of pinewood may apply within all or part of these areas.
EHB Restricted Movement Zones are subject to change. See the DPIRD website for up to date specific information on EHB RMZs and requirements.

Layer.Title: Wheatbelt of WA (DPIRD-024)
Layer.Abstract:
The Wheatbelt boundary of Western Australia defines the area of cropping for wheat in Western Australia. This dataset was created in August 2009 to accurately define the limit of cropping for wheat in Western Australia. The western/southern limit was defined using interpretation of the best available aerial photography. The Clearing Line October 2002 was used to define the eastern limit of cropping. The data set updated in June 2012 to incorporate 2011 recapture of the Clearing Line to define the eastern limit of cropping.

Layer.Title: Native Title (Determination) (LGATE-066)
Layer.Abstract:
This dataset contains the external spatial extent of all Native Title Applications within Western Australia that have been determined by the Federal Court of Australia. This dataset is a spatial depiction of the last stage of the Native Title process. When a Determination of Native Title over an Application has been handed down from the Federal Court (by litigation or mediation) the Application is captured in this dataset.

Layer.Abstract:
This dataset contains the external spatial extent of all Indigenous Land Use Agreements (ILUA) within Western Australia, which has been registered or is in notification with the National Native Title Tribunal (NNTT). This dataset is a spatial depiction of ILUAs that can be made outside of the Native Title process but can still be part of a Native Title Determination. When an ILUA is registered or in notification with NNTT the extent of the agreement is captured in this dataset.

Layer.Title: State Electorates [Proposed] (LGATE-133)
Layer.Abstract:
MLA and MLC boundaries are updated every four years prior to the State General Election. The current electoral dataset (LGATE-069) depicts the State Electoral Districts and Regions that were used in the State General Election of March 2017.
This dataset describes the PROPOSED MLA and MLC boundaries that were Gazetted on 27th November 2019. They will be used in the next State General Election to be held on 13th March 2021. If a by-election is held before the next State General Election, the 2017 boundaries will still apply.

Layer.Title: State Electorates [Current] (LGATE-069)
Layer.Abstract:
MLA and MLC boundaries are updated every four years prior to the state elections. The current electoral dataset depicts the State Electoral Districts and Regions that were used in the State Election of March 2013. These districts and regions are described by technical description, and were published under the Electoral Act 1907, in the Govt Gazette on 10th October 2011. The current state electoral dataset that depicts the MLA District and the MLC Region boundaries remain the current dataset until the next state election is declared. Therefore, if a By-election is declared for any district prior to the next State General Election, this is the dataset that must be used.

Layer.Title: Ward Boundaries (LGATE-249)
Layer.Abstract: LGA Wards are divisions within an LGA used for the election of councillors. Not all LGAs have to be divided into wards. The extents of the LGA Wards are defined by technical descriptions and published in the Government Gazette. Derived from the Spatial Cadastral Database (SCDB) and based on GDA.

Layer.Title: Districts (LGATE-229)
Layer.Abstract: The Land District is the highest level of land division used for land titling in WA, under the Land Act. Numeric locations created within a district were originally used to describe land parcels. Now land is described as Lot on Plan, and so Land Districts are used more for descriptive purposes today. Derived from the Spatial Cadastral Database (SCDB) and based on GDA 94. Updated regularly when amendments/changes are formalised.

Layer.Title: Localities (LGATE-234)
Layer.Abstract: Locality Boundaries for the State of Western Australia. Generally, Post Code boundaries coincide with the Locality boundaries. Derived from the Spatial Cadastral Database (SCDB) and based on GDA 94. Updated regularly when amendments/changes are formalised.

Layer.Title: Townsites (LGATE-248)
Layer.Abstract: Townsites are the urban centres described by technical description. A townsite must be approved (by document) by the Minister for Lands, under the Land Administration Act 1997. A townsite consists of urban land, rather than rural land. Derived from the Spatial Cadastral Database (SCDB) and based on GDA 94. Updated regularly when amendments/changes are formalised.

Layer.Title: Local Government Authority (LGA) Boundaries (LGATE-233)
Layer.Abstract: Local Government Authority and Locality Boundaries for the State of Western Australia. Generally, Post Code boundaries coincide with the Locality boundaries. Derived from the Spatial Cadastral Database (SCDB) and based on GDA 94. Updated regularly when amendments/changes are formalised.

Layer.Title: Port Authorities (LGATE-243)
Layer.Abstract: Port Authorities for the State of Western Australia. As originally declared under individual Port Authority Acts (7) and more recently declared under the Port Authorities Act 1999 (2). Derived from the Spatial Cadastral Database (SCDB) and based on GDA 94. Updated regularly when amendments/changes to boundaries are formalised, all of which are now gazetted under the Port Authorities Act 1999. This dataset uses the W_LAND_ADM_CUR_ALL_VIEW layer which identifies all polygons in the SCDB with a Port Authority usage code of 190.

Layer.Title: State Border (LGATE-245)
Layer.Abstract: The State Border of Western Australia, which separates WA from South Australia and the Northern Territory, and situated approximately on the 129 degrees East, Meridian of Longitude. Derived from the Spatial Cadastral Database (SCDB) and based on GDA 94.

Layer.Title: DBCA Region Boundaries (DBCA-022)
Layer.Abstract: CALM's administrative region boundaries renamed to DEC, DPaW and subsequently DBCA Region Boundaries. The Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions administers a variety of environmental services to the public through 9 regional offices throughout Western Australia. The boundaries define the jurisdictional boundaries for regional offices to deploy DBCA services.

Layer.Title: Regional Parks (DBCA-026)
Layer.Abstract: The Regional Parks Unit (formally known as the Regional Parks Branch) was set up in 1997 to coordinate the management of Perth's regional parks. This network of regional parks represents the majority of land reserved for parks and recreation in the metropolitan area. The current land tenure arrangements within the regional parks are complex with a number of different landholders of both Crown and freehold lands. The Regional Parks Unit works closely with local government authorities and the community to manage these diverse multi-purpose parks for the enjoyment of local residents and visitors. The Western Australian Planning Commission has proceeded to, and will continue to, acquire the land that is required to consolidate the parks.
